correctness.rationale: For B={|x_i|≤1, ∑|x_i|≤3/2}, axial and body-diagonal Voronoi bisectors give exactly the displayed facets, and FCC H={|x_i|+|x_j|≤2} has volume 16 while B has volume 4. Scaling H by 4^{-1/3} makes both volumes 4. Distances to a polytope boundary are minima of signed supporting-facet Euclidean distances; B_t is {|x_i|≤1−t, ∑|x_i|≤3/2−sqrt(3)t}. In 0≤t≤T=(1+sqrt(3))/4 one has 0≤b−a and b<2a, making six removed axial octahedron caps pairwise disjoint; each has exactly 2(b−a)^3/3 volume. Thus normalized S_B=b^3/3−(b−a)^3 and on T≤t≤r_B=sqrt(3)/2 cube facets become redundant so S_B=b^3/3. Rhombic dodecahedron is tangential and its inward facets homothetically scale, giving S_F=(1−t/2^{-1/6})^3 to r_F. Fresh independent SymPy exact integration confirms E D_B=(17sqrt(3)−1)/128 and E D_F=2^{-1/6}/4, plus the BCC second moment. On the early interval S_B−S_F=tQ(t) with Q0>0, Q2>0, Q(T)<0 certified by rational brackets, proving exactly one positive root. After T the cube roots b/3^(1/3) and 1−t/r_F are affine, strictly ordered at T and r_B; no additional positive nonterminal crossover. r_B<r_F and exact rational bounds prove the FCC mean advantage. The signed inequalities, domain endpoints t=0,T,r_B,r_F and zero-tail cases are covered, not numerically extrapolated.

originality.rationale: The general polytope piecewise-cubic inner-tube result and special tangential-polytope FCC law are prior mathematics, as are static Voronoi cell parameters and global BCC surface-area minimization. Reviewed closest original sources do not state or imply the exact non-tangential BCC two-phase clearance law together with the single BCC/FCC survival crossing and strict reversed clearance-mean order. Three new semantic searches of published mathematical findings and targeted alias queries did not identify independent coverage; self-match is not priority evidence. Best-of-knowledge PASS subject to documented unindexed contact/erosion literature risk; this decision does not declare the FCC formula itself novel.
residual_risks: Older unindexed contact-distribution, erosion/inner-parallel volume, or periodic Voronoi interface-distance research may tabulate the exact same two-cell functions under different terminology.
A short general theorem about stochastic order of convex polytope erosions could conceivably imply the crossing; no dominating statement identified in examined primary literature.
The FCC cubic is not independently novel; it follows directly from the tangential-polytope inner-volume theorem. The BCC/FCC combined crossing and mean reversal are the assessed novelty.
Best-of-knowledge historical comparison is not a claim of exhaustive publication priority.

value.rationale: Uniform interior clearance is a canonical geometric/integral-geometric invariant for Voronoi tessellation cells. The BCC and FCC cells are canonical equal-volume lattice comparators, not arbitrary slices. The full distributional crossover supplies a geometric counterexample to inferring mean or deep-boundary-clearance optimality from the known BCC surface-area optimum: BCC wins at shallow depths but loses for all deeper nonterminal depths and has strictly smaller mean. The mean gap is small, but its sign and the uniquely classified full-depth reversal are exact and mathematically motivated. This is an independently useful benchmark for lattice contact distributions and erosion, without claiming a global lattice optimum or new generic polytope tube theorem.
residual_risks: The result does not classify all parallelohedra, optimize clearance among lattices, or quantify perturbation stability.
FCC mean advantage is about 0.000499 in the volume-four normalization; significance rests on full strict CDF reversal, not the magnitude of the mean gap.

limitations: Euclidean metric, uniform 3D volume distribution, and these two fixed volume-four canonical shapes only; no arbitrary lattice extremal theorem.
